content.text: Earlier this year, he nearly achieved a second major victory by rallying from seven strokes down on the final day of the Masters, ultimately pushing the match to a play-off with the eventual champion, Rory McIlroy.

Rory McIlroy wears a white cap and grey polo shirt. He wears a white glove in his left hand. He looks like he has just finished a swing and is holding a driver in his hands. He is looking up into the air like he is following the ball. There is blurred greenery behind him.
